purpose: Define DWH output from the resolved semantic schema and applicable authorization context rather than mirroring arbitrary input shape or transport payload.

topics.name: DWH Output Schema
topics.purpose: Define DWH output from the resolved semantic schema and applicable authorization context rather than mirroring arbitrary input shape or transport payload.

semantics.schema_rule: Output schema is resolved from the owning semantic schema/Meta context.
semantics.input_output_rule: Input shape does not determine output shape.
semantics.authorization_rule: Output is filtered by applicable data/remote authorization after schema resolution.
semantics.unknown_field_rule: Fields outside resolved schema are not emitted unless explicit extension semantics permit them.
semantics.projection_rule: Projection may select a subset but may not invent fields.
semantics.trace_rule: Output retains schema provenance and authorization provenance.

invariants.rule: DWH local/remote, origin, schema, external identity, access path and transport-security semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: output shape mirrors arbitrary input payload
output includes fields outside resolved schema without extension semantics

references.purpose: DWH output schema is explicitly owned/resolved.
Input and output scopes remain separate.
